subject: Staffing validation artifacts request - onboarding/offboarding & training
messages:
From: Melissa Hopkins <melissa.hopkins@cedarbridge.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: audits@cedarbridge.com
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: sample artifacts for onboarding/offboarding & training (SOC 2)

Hi Rishi,

I'm working through CedarBridge's SOC 2 scoping and we need an evidence sample from Redwood covering employee onboarding, background checks, training completion, and offboarding controls. Specifically we ask for:

- A sample cohort (approx 20-30 employees) hired between Jan 2026 and Dec 2027 with: hire date, role, training completion date (security awareness + data handling), and confirmation of background check completion. PII may be redacted.
- A summary of background-check providers and the scope of checks run.
- Access revocation logs for leavers in that cohort (timing relative to termination).
- The redaction approach and a manifest showing how IDs were hashed/pseudonymized (we don't need raw SSNs).

Please let me know if you prefer a subset by role (engineering/platform) or a straight random sample. We need the bundle by 2028-02-17 to meet our audit timeline.

Thanks,
Melissa Hopkins
Senior IT Audit Manager
CedarBridge Financial
melissa.hopkins@cedarbridge.com

Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 10:05:24 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: sample artifacts for onboarding/offboarding & training (SOC 2)

Team — forwarding CedarBridge's ask (below). Can we assemble a minimally redacted sample set and confirm owners? Key constraints: no raw SSNs, replace personal identifiers with hashed IDs and include a manifest describing the hashing method.

Proposed owners:
- Priyom: generate training & onboarding CSVs (include hashed_id, hire_date, role, training_dates)
- Kimberly (HR): confirm background-check vendor summary and provide redaction manifest
- Vivek: pull access-revocation timestamps from IAM audit logs and map to hashed_id

Deadline CedarBridge gave: 2028-02-17 COB. Can we make it? If not, propose latest date. Also confirm where we will stage artifacts (Drive link or secure SFTP).

Thanks — Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Enterprise Sales (Americas)
Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: sample artifacts for onboarding/offboarding & training (SOC 2)

Rishi / Kimberly / Vivek —

I can assemble the CSV exports and a short evidence bundle. Proposed artifact list (to be delivered in a single ZIP):

1) onboard-training-logs-2026-2027.csv — columns: hashed_id, hire_date, business_unit, role, security_awareness_complete_date, data_handling_training_date, training_version
2) bg-check-summary-redacted.pdf — one-page sheet listing vendor name(s), check types (ID verification, criminal, employment verification) and per-hire status (Completed / Cleared / Withdrawn). Individual PII will be redacted; we will map to hashed_id.
3) offboard-access-revocations-2026-2027.csv — columns: hashed_id, termination_date, accounts_revoked (list), revocation_timestamp_utc
4) redaction-manifest-2028.txt — description of hashing approach (SHA-256 with salt stored in KMS), sample hashed mapping (non-reversible) and redaction checklist
5) cedarbridge-audit-delivery-notes-2028.pdf — short cover note with contacts and chain-of-custody statements

Staging: I will place the ZIP in a restricted Google Drive folder and share a link with view-only access for Melissa's team. For extra security we can provide an SFTP drop or a signed URL.

I will run the training-log export overnight; Kimberley, can you confirm background vendor name and whether we need to remove contractor records? Also Vivek — can you confirm IAM logs can be exported by EOD Thursday?

— Priyom
Priyom Das
Security & Compliance Engineer
Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com

Priyom / Rishi —

Confirming background-check provider: CheckPoint Services (third-party vendor contracted Jan 2025). Scope: ID verification, national criminal search, employment verification (US & CA). We do not store SSNs in HR system; the vendor returns a clearance boolean and report ID. We will provide the report IDs mapped to hashed_id and a vendor attestation statement.

Attached is the redaction-manifest that explains how we pseudonymize internal IDs (hash + per-batch salt) and the checks we apply to ensure no PII leaks. We will exclude contingent contractors by default — if CedarBridge wants contractors included, let me know.

Forwarding the manifest below (excerpt):

Hi Melissa —

Thanks for the clear scope. Attached is the evidence bundle we prepared for your review. Files included (all PII removed or pseudonymized as explained in the manifest):

- onboard-training-logs-2026-2027.csv (CSV export, hashed_id column)
- bg-check-summary-redacted.pdf (vendor summary + per-hire status mapped to hashed_id)
- offboard-access-revocations-2026-2027.csv (access revocation timestamps)
- redaction-manifest-2028.txt (description of hashing method and redaction checklist)
- cedarbridge-audit-delivery-notes-2028.pdf (cover note & chain-of-custody)

Staging/Access: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDeFgOnboardEvidence (view-only, restricted to cedarbridge domain). If you need SFTP or encrypted bundle delivery, we can provide immediately.

Notes and caveats:
- Background checks were performed by CheckPoint Services; Redwood retains only the vendor report IDs and clearance indicators, not raw vendor reports. If CedarBridge needs the vendor attestation letter we can request and include it.
- For offboard revocations we provide timestamps for IAM and SSO account revocations; hardware return logs are not included in this sample set.
- Contractors were excluded per Kimberly's note; we can produce a separate contractor cohort on request.

Point of contact: Priyom Das (priyom_das@redwood.com) for technical evidence questions; Kimberly Park (kimberly_park@redwood.com) for HR attestations; Vivek for IAM-specific logs.

Please confirm receipt and if the format works for your audit.
